newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea's KFA buys 12,000T of wheat bran pellet.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea's KFA buys 12,000T of wheat bran pellet.

text.p: South Korea's Korea Feed Association (KFA) bought 12,000 tonnes of Indonesian wheat bran pellet on Thursday from Bogasari Flour Mills in a tender, traders said.
One trader said KFA bought the wheat bran pellet at 126.20 won/kilogram on a cost and freight basis. Others said the purchase was made at around $134 per tonne, C&F.
They said shipment was set for December 17-January 5.
Arrival was slated for January 20 to the port cities of Inchon and Pusan, or Ulsan.
